why: Adding the numeric-preservation principle made the model prefer cuts that keep a numeral with its multipliers/units, which raised H_set on short pieces (≤10-word bins) but caused more harmful cuts in long contexts (≤99) by displacing cuts into enumerations and noun phrases; the bin breakdown (positive up to ≤10, negative at ≤99) and the tail examples show the tradeoff.
lesson: A later revision should preserve numeral+unit spans only when it does not conflict with protections against splitting heads, named entities, or enumeration boundaries in longer contexts.
